# openstatus_grpc_monitor (Resource)

Manages a gRPC monitor. The probe calls `grpc.health.v1.Health/Check` on the target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_grpc_monitor" "api" {
  name        = "API gRPC Health"
  uri         = "grpc.example.com:443"
  periodicity = "1m"
  service     = "my.package.Service"
  tls_mode    = "tls"
  active      = true
  regions     = ["fly-iad", "fly-fra"]

  metadata {
    key   = "authorization"
    value = "Bearer ${var.grpc_token}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `periodicity` (String)
- `uri` (String) Target in host:port format. IPv6 addresses must be bracketed.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `degraded_at` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `metadata` (Block List) Metadata sent with the health check request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))
- `open_telemetry` (Block, Optional) OpenTelemetry exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open_telemetry))
- `public` (Boolean)
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions to monitor from.
- `retry` (Number)
- `service` (String) Service name passed to `Health/Check`. Leave unset to check overall server health.
- `timeout` (Number)
- `tls_mode` (String) How the connection to the target is secured. One of `tls` (verify the certificate), `plaintext` (h2c) or `tls_insecure` (TLS without certificate verification).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_location_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the private locations that run this monitor. Managed from `openstatus_private_location.monitor_ids`.
- `status` (String)
